exclusions: Production deployment, key custody and ingress configuration are not observed by repository inspection.
SENATRAN real-provider payload and operational assurance are not inferred from mock tests.

assets: Tenant-scoped citizen, driver, vehicle, case and sensitive health records
Authorization context, callback authentication material and session identity
Transactional command state, audit integrity and idempotency records
CI control sources, immutable evidence and trusted local RC attestations

boundaries.name: Untrusted browser/client to authenticated backend
boundaries.flow: Apps and external clients send requests to the sole NestJS composition root.
threats: Forged or absent principal; missing policy metadata; unauthorized read/write; cross-tenant or cross-agency access.
gaps: The source and decorator census do not establish every contextual negative case or production identity configuration.

boundaries.name: Request transaction to PostgreSQL schemas
boundaries.flow: Tenant context governs domain reads/writes in one PostgreSQL database.
threats: Tenant escape; owner-role request bypass; partial command persistence; sensitive-data exposure.
gaps: Coverage of BOAT contracts and named RLS suites must not be generalized to every table or deployment role.
PII purpose, legal basis and retention remain source-scoped; unresolved C4 rows are not silently approved.

boundaries.name: External callback to tenant-scoped integration principal
boundaries.flow: RENACH callbacks authenticate exact raw bytes and bind tenant/event/timestamp before principal creation.
threats: Forged signature; changed body; invalid tenant; expired replay; absent secret.
gaps: Timestamp-window rejection does not alone prove durable duplicate-event prevention.
Secret rotation, storage and ingress transport assurance require operational evidence.

boundaries.name: Domain to national-system adapter
boundaries.flow: Domains call packages/senatran-adapter, which maps mock or real provider responses.
threats: Direct bypass; provider payload drift; retry duplication; upstream failure misclassification.
gaps: Mock contracts do not validate real-provider schemas or production timeout/circuit configuration.

boundaries.name: Contributor-controlled candidate to trusted CI verifier
boundaries.flow: Required CI checks validate code and evidence; protected verifier controls validate signed exact-tree claims.
threats: Forged/stale evidence; candidate-controlled verifier; missing required check; simultaneous runs cancelling unrelated subjects.
gaps: Static workflow review does not replace remote check completion, protected environment policy or signature validation.
Historical missing records remain explicit gaps, even when the preserved proof chain verifies.

limitations: This assessment documents existing controls and threats; listed test paths are reproducible checks, not claims of fresh execution.
No legal basis or retention period is established here. Existing legal drafts and unresolved institutional questions retain that status.
Resource/Action metadata alone does not prove contextual authorization; public routes and mock populations require their own controls.
No new product mitigation, role permission, deadline or runtime retry policy is introduced.
